event_chain.summary: Portal vulnerability exploited; customer account data downloaded

summary: London Hydro, the municipally owned electricity distributor for London, Ontario, noticed unusual account activity on its customer web portal around June 18, 2026. A technical issue in the portal had allowed an unauthorized third party to access and download data from some customer accounts: names, emails, mailing addresses, phone numbers, account numbers, service addresses, pricing plans, contract start dates, meter numbers and meter types. Passwords, banking, payment card and government ID data were not involved. London Hydro fixed the flaw the same day, offered Equifax credit monitoring, and on October 2, 2026 London police charged a London man in connection with the unauthorized access.
